PlatformFeeRateUpdated(oldRate, newFeeRate);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Update fee collector address\r\n     * @param newFeeCollector New fee collector address\r\n     */\r\n    function setFeeCollector(\r\n        address newFeeCollector\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (newFeeCollector == address(0)) revert LendingPool__ZeroAddress();\r\n        feeCollector = newFeeCollector;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Set the CoSigningManager address\r\n     * @dev Called once after both contracts are deployed. Can be updated by admin.\r\n     * @param _coSigningManager Address of the deployed CoSigningManager\r\n     */\r\n    function setCoSigningManager(\r\n        address _coSigningManager\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (_coSigningManager == address(0)) revert LendingPool__ZeroAddress();\r\n        address old = address(coSigningManager);\r\n        coSigningManager = CoSigningManager(_coSigningManager);\r\n        emit CoSigningManagerUpdated(old, _coSigningManager);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Internal Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Complete loan repayment and unlock collateral\r\n     */\r\n    function _completeLoanRepayment(uint256 loanId) internal {\r\n        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];\r\n\r\n        loan.status = LoanStatus.REPAID;\r\n\r\n        // Unlock collateral\r\n        if (loan.terms.collateralAmount > 0) {\r\n            collateralManager.unlockCollateral(loan.collateralDepositId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Update borrower reputation\r\n        reputationManager.recordSuccessfulRepayment(\r\n            loan.borrower,\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Update lender reputation\r\n        reputationManager.recordSuccessfulRepayment(\r\n            loan.lender,\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Reward co-signer if one exists\r\n        if (loan.hasCoSigner) {\r\n            reputationManager.rewardCoSigner(loan.coSigner, loan.borrower);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        if (loan.hasCoSigner && address(coSigningManager) != address(0)) {\r\n            // Find the record ID(s) for this loan\r\n            uint256[] memory recordIds = coSigningManager.getLoanCoSigners(\r\n                loanId\r\n            );\r\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n                coSigningManager.releaseCoSigning(recordIds[i], true); // true = successful\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanRepaid(loanId, loan.borrower, loan.amountRepaid);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Validate loan terms\r\n     */\r\n    function _validateLoanTerms(\r\n        LoanTerms calldata terms,\r\n        LoanType offerType\r\n    ) internal pure {\r\n        if (terms.principalAmount == 0) revert LendingPool__InvalidAmount();\r\n        if (\r\n            terms.duration < MIN_LOAN_DURATION ||\r\n            terms.duration > MAX_LOAN_DURATION\r\n        ) revert LendingPool__InvalidDuration();\r\n        if (terms.interestRate > MAX_INTEREST_RATE)\r\n            revert LendingPool__InvalidInterestRate();\r\n\r\n        if (offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            // Lender sets the ratio as a requirement for the borrower.\r\n            // A ratio of 0 means uncollateralized; otherwise enforce the floor.\r\n            if (\r\n                terms.collateralRatio != 0 &&\r\n                terms.collateralRatio < MIN_COLLATERAL_RATIO\r\n            ) revert LendingPool__InvalidCollateralRatio();\r\n        } else {\r\n            // Borrower request: they pre-deposit collateral themselves.\r\n            // If they specify an amount, the ratio must meet the floor.\r\n            // If no collateral, ratio must also be 0.\r\n            if (terms.collateralAmount > 0) {\r\n                if (terms.collateralRatio < MIN_COLLATERAL_RATIO)\r\n                    revert LendingPool__InvalidCollateralRatio();\r\n            } else {\r\n                if (terms.collateralRatio != 0)\r\n                    revert LendingPool__InvalidCollateralRatio();\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Remove offer from active list\r\n     */\r\n    function _removeFromActiveList(\r\n        uint256 offerId,\r\n        LoanType offerType\r\n    ) internal {\r\n        uint256[] storage activeList = offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER\r\n            ? activeLenderOffers\r\n            : activeBorrowerRequests;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < activeList.length; i++) {\r\n            if (activeList[i] == offerId) {\r\n                activeList[i] = activeList[activeList.length - 1];\r\n                activeList.pop();\r\n                break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0x0dc90c13c8fd0d2c2cbda37205c76ddab7717d04ceec6f1415fbe8ff1f9cf5e4","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/LoanLogic.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nlibrary LoanLogic {\r\n    uint256 internal constant BASIS_POINTS = 10000;\r\n\r\n    function calculateAmountDue(\r\n        uint256 principal,\r\n        uint256 interestRate\r\n    ) internal pure returns (uint256) {\r\n        return principal + (principal * interestRate) / BASIS_POINTS;\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0x010dcac8a75869a5dfdde424cc73ee767d346716728b4427912496c615e68677","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/PriceOracle.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@chainlink/contracts/src/v0.8/shared/interfaces/AggregatorV3Interface.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * @title PriceOracle\r\n * @notice Wrapper contract for Chainlink price feeds\r\n * @dev Provides unified interface for getting token prices in USD\r\n */\r\ncontract PriceOracle is Ownable {\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    // Mapping from token address to Chainlink price feed\r\n    mapping(address => AggregatorV3Interface) public priceFeeds;\r\n\r\n    // Mapping to track supported tokens\r\n    mapping(address => bool) public isSupportedToken;\r\n\r\n    // Array of all supported tokens\r\n    address[] public supportedTokens;\r\n\r\n    // Stale price threshold (default: 1 hour)\r\n    uint256 public stalePriceThreshold = 1 hours;\r\n\r\n    // Price deviation threshold for additional validation (in basis points)\r\n    // e.g., 5000 = 50% deviation allowed\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_PRICE_DEVIATION = 5000; // 50%\r\n\r\n    // Decimals for USD price (standardized to 18 decimals)\r\n    uint8 public constant PRICE_DECIMALS = 18;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct PriceData {\r\n        uint256 price; // Price in USD (18 decimals)\r\n        uint256 timestamp; // When price was updated\r\n        uint80 roundId; // Chainlink round ID\r\n        bool isValid; // Whether price is valid\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event PriceFeedUpdated(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        address indexed priceFeed,\r\n        string tokenSymbol\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event PriceFeedRemoved(address indexed token);\r\n\r\n    event PriceRetrieved(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        uint256 price,\r\n        uint256 timestamp\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event StalePriceThresholdUpdated(\r\n        uint256 oldThreshold,\r\n        uint256 newThreshold\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event PriceValidationFailed(address indexed token, string reason);\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error PriceOracle__InvalidPriceFeed();\r\n    error PriceOracle__PriceFeedNotSet();\r\n    error PriceOracle__StalePrice(uint256 timeSinceUpdate);\r\n    error PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n    error PriceOracle__InvalidRoundData();\r\n    error PriceOracle__TokenAlreadySupported();\r\n    error PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n    error PriceOracle__InvalidThreshold();\r\n    error PriceOracle__ZeroAddress();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor() Ownable() {}\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Set or update price feed for a token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param priceFeed The Chainlink price feed address\r\n     * @param tokenSymbol The token symbol (for events)\r\n     */\r\n    function setPriceFeed(\r\n        address token,\r\n        address priceFeed,\r\n        string calldata tokenSymbol\r\n    ) external onlyOwner {\r\n        if (token == address(0)) revert PriceOracle__ZeroAddress();\r\n        if (priceFeed == address(0)) revert PriceOracle__InvalidPriceFeed();\r\n\r\n        // Validate price feed by attempting to get latest round data\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface feed = AggregatorV3Interface(priceFeed);\r\n        try feed.latestRoundData() returns (\r\n            uint80,\r\n            int256 answer,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint80\r\n        ) {\r\n            if (answer <= 0) revert PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n        } catch {\r\n            revert PriceOracle__InvalidPriceFeed();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Add to supported tokens if new\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) {\r\n            supportedTokens.push(token);\r\n            isSupportedToken[token] = true;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        priceFeeds[token] = feed;\r\n        emit PriceFeedUpdated(token, priceFeed, tokenSymbol);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Remove a price feed for a token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     */\r\n    function removePriceFeed(address token) external onlyOwner {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) revert PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n\r\n        delete priceFeeds[token];\r\n        isSupportedToken[token] = false;\r\n\r\n        // Remove from supported tokens array\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < supportedTokens.length; i++) {\r\n            if (supportedTokens[i] == token) {\r\n                supportedTokens[i] = supportedTokens[\r\n                    supportedTokens.length - 1\r\n                ];\r\n                supportedTokens.pop();\r\n                break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit PriceFeedRemoved(token);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the latest price for a token in USD\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return price The price in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     */\r\n    function getPrice(address token) external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        PriceData memory priceData = _getPriceData(token);\r\n\r\n        if (!priceData.isValid) {\r\n            revert PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return priceData.price;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get detailed price data for a token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return priceData Struct containing price, timestamp, and validity\r\n     */\r\n    function getPriceData(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external view returns (PriceData memory) {\r\n        return _getPriceData(token);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get token value in USD\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param amount The token amount (in token's native decimals)\r\n     * @param tokenDecimals The token's decimal places\r\n     * @return valueInUSD The value in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     */\r\n    function getTokenValueInUSD(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint8 tokenDecimals\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 valueInUSD) {\r\n        uint256 price = this.getPrice(token);\r\n\r\n        // Normalize token amount to 18 decimals, then multiply by price\r\n        if (tokenDecimals <= 18) {\r\n            uint256 normalizedAmount = amount * (10 ** (18 - tokenDecimals));\r\n            valueInUSD = (normalizedAmount * price) / 1e18;\r\n        } else {\r\n            // If token has > 18 decimals (rare), scale down\r\n            uint256 normalizedAmount = amount / (10 ** (tokenDecimals - 18));\r\n            valueInUSD = (normalizedAmount * price) / 1e18;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return valueInUSD;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get USD amount required for specific token amount\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param usdAmount The USD amount desired (18 decimals)\r\n     * @param tokenDecimals The token's decimal places\r\n     * @return tokenAmount The token amount needed\r\n     */\r\n    function getTokenAmountForUSD(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 usdAmount,\r\n        uint8 tokenDecimals\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 tokenAmount) {\r\n        uint256 price = this.getPrice(token);\r\n\r\n        if (price == 0) revert PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n\r\n        // Calculate token amount needed (in 18 decimals)\r\n        uint256 tokenAmount18Decimals = (usdAmount * 1e18) / price;\r\n\r\n        // Convert to token's native decimals\r\n        if (tokenDecimals <= 18) {\r\n            tokenAmount = tokenAmount18Decimals / (10 ** (18 - tokenDecimals));\r\n        } else {\r\n            tokenAmount = tokenAmount18Decimals * (10 ** (tokenDecimals - 18));\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return tokenAmount;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if a price is stale\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return isStale True if price is stale\r\n     */\r\n    function isPriceStale(address token) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) return true;\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n\r\n        try priceFeed.latestRoundData() returns (\r\n            uint80,\r\n            int256,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint256 updatedAt,\r\n            uint80\r\n        ) {\r\n            return block.timestamp - updatedAt > stalePriceThreshold;\r\n        } catch {\r\n            return true;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all supported tokens\r\n     * @return Array of supported token addresses\r\n     */\r\n    function getSupportedTokens() external view returns (address[] memory) {\r\n        return supportedTokens;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the number of supported tokens\r\n     * @return count The count of supported tokens\r\n     */\r\n    function getSupportedTokenCount() external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return supportedTokens.length;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Update stale price threshold\r\n     * @param newThreshold New threshold in seconds\r\n     */\r\n    function setStalePriceThreshold(uint256 newThreshold) external onlyOwner {\r\n        if (newThreshold == 0 || newThreshold > 1 days) {\r\n            revert PriceOracle__InvalidThreshold();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        uint256 oldThreshold = stalePriceThreshold;\r\n        stalePriceThreshold = newThreshold;\r\n\r\n        emit StalePriceThresholdUpdated(oldThreshold, newThreshold);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get price feed decimals for a token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return decimals The decimals of the price feed\r\n     */\r\n    function getPriceFeedDecimals(address token) external view returns (uint8) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) revert PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n        return priceFeed.decimals();\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get price feed description for a token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return description The description of the price feed\r\n     */\r\n    function getPriceFeedDescription(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external view returns (string memory) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) revert PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n        return priceFeed.description();\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Internal Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Internal function to get price data with validation\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return priceData Struct containing price information\r\n     */\r\n    function _getPriceData(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) internal view returns (PriceData memory priceData) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) revert PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n        if (address(priceFeed) == address(0))\r\n            revert PriceOracle__PriceFeedNotSet();\r\n\r\n        try priceFeed.latestRoundData() returns (\r\n            uint80 roundId,\r\n            int256 answer,\r\n            uint256 startedAt,\r\n            uint256 updatedAt,\r\n            uint80 answeredInRound\r\n        ) {\r\n            // Validate round data\r\n            if (answeredInRound < roundId) {\r\n                priceData.isValid = false;\r\n                return priceData;\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Check for stale price\r\n            uint256 timeSinceUpdate = block.timestamp - updatedAt;\r\n            if (timeSinceUpdate > stalePriceThreshold) {\r\n                revert PriceOracle__StalePrice(timeSinceUpdate);\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Check for invalid price\r\n            if (answer <= 0) {\r\n                revert PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Get price feed decimals and normalize to 18 decimals\r\n            uint8 decimals = priceFeed.decimals();\r\n            uint256 price;\r\n\r\n            if (decimals < PRICE_DECIMALS) {\r\n                price = uint256(answer) * (10 ** (PRICE_DECIMALS - decimals));\r\n            } else if (decimals > PRICE_DECIMALS) {\r\n                price = uint256(answer) / (10 ** (decimals - PRICE_DECIMALS));\r\n            } else {\r\n                price = uint256(answer);\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            priceData = PriceData({\r\n                price: price,\r\n                timestamp: updatedAt,\r\n                roundId: roundId,\r\n                isValid: true\r\n            });\r\n        } catch {\r\n            revert PriceOracle__InvalidRoundData();\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if price feed is responsive\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return isResponsive True if price feed is working\r\n     */\r\n    function _isPriceFeedResponsive(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) internal view returns (bool) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) return false;\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n\r\n        try priceFeed.latestRoundData() returns (\r\n            uint80,\r\n            int256 answer,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint80\r\n        ) {\r\n            return answer > 0;\r\n        } catch {\r\n            return false;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0xc695bf2655a7dcd76f6d21fdd2ed54ae46eccfefb465c27974d0f15cce4538df","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/ReputationManager.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * @title ReputationManager\r\n * @notice Manages user reputation scores for decentralized lending platform\r\n * @dev Implements multi-factor reputation system with decay, anti-gaming, and co-signing\r\n */\r\ncontract ReputationManager is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    bytes32 public constant LENDING_POOL_ROLE = keccak256(\"LENDING_POOL_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant COSIGNING_ROLE = keccak256(\"COSIGNING_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant VERIFIER_ROLE = keccak256(\"VERIFIER_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant DATA_FEED_ROLE = keccak256(\"DATA_FEED_ROLE\");\r\n\r\n    // Reputation score bounds\r\n    uint256 public constant MIN_REPUTATION = 0;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_REPUTATION = 1000;\r\n    uint256 public constant STARTING_REPUTATION = 100;\r\n\r\n    // Reputation weights (out of 100 for percentage)\r\n    uint256 public constant REPAYMENT_WEIGHT = 50; // 50% weight\r\n    uint256 public constant TRANSACTION_WEIGHT = 25; // 25% weight\r\n    uint256 public constant COSIGNING_WEIGHT = 15; // 15% weight\r\n    uint256 public constant WALLET_AGE_WEIGHT = 10; // 10% weight\r\n\r\n    // Decay parameters\r\n    uint256 public constant DECAY_START_DAYS = 90; // Start decay after 90 days of inactivity\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_DECAY_PERCENTAGE =  address[] public supportedTokenList;\r\n\r\n    // Counters\r\n    uint256 public nextDepositId;\r\n\r\n    // Liquidation parameters\r\n    uint256 public constant LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD = 11000; // uint256 public constant BASIS_POINTS = 10000; // 100%\r\n\r\n    // Grace period before liquidation (to give borrower time to add collateral)\r\n    uint256 public constant LIQUIDATION_GRACE_PERIOD = uint256 amount;\r\n        uint256 loanId;\r\n        bool isLocked;\r\n        uint256 depositTimestamp;\r\n        uint256 lockedTimestamp;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct TokenInfo {\r\n        bool isSupported;\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount; // Max amount that can be deposited\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty; // Penalty on liquidation (basis points)\r\n        uint256 totalDeposited; // Total amount currently deposited\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct CollateralValue {\r\n        address tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 amount;\r\n        uint256 valueInUSD;\r\n        uint256 lastUpdated;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event CollateralDeposited(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        address indexed depositor,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint256 timestamp\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralWithdrawn(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        address indexed depositor,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralLocked(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint256 timestamp\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralUnlocked(\r\n        uint256 indexed );\r\n\r\n    event TokenAdded(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event TokenRemoved(address indexed token);\r\n\r\n    event TokenConfigUpdated(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n    error CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n    error CollateralManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n    error CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n    error CollateralManager__DepositLocked();\r\n    error CollateralManager__DepositNotLocked();\r\n    error CollateralManager__UnauthorizedWithdrawal();\r\n    error CollateralManager__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n    error CollateralManager__CannotLiquidate();\r\n    error CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n    error CollateralManager__MaxDepositExceeded();\r\n    error CollateralManager__TransferFailed();\r\n    error CollateralManager__GracePeriodActive();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor(address _priceOracle) {\r\n        if (_priceOracle == address(0)) revert CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n\r\n        priceOracle = PriceOracle(_priceOracle);\r\n\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n        _grantRole(LIQUIDATOR_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n\r\n        nextDepositId = 1;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Add a supported collateral token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param decimals_ The token decimals\r\n     * @param maxDepositAmount Maximum deposit amount\r\n     * @param liquidationPenalty Liquidation penalty in basis points\r\n     */\r\n    function addSupportedToken(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint8 decimals_,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (token == address(0)) revert CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n        if (supportedTokens[token].isSupported)\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n\r\n        // Verify token is supported by price oracle\r\n        if (!priceOracle.isSupportedToken(token)) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token] = TokenInfo({\r\n            isSupported: true,\r\n            maxDepositAmount: maxDepositAmount,\r\n            liquidationPenalty: liquidationPenalty,\r\n            totalDeposited: 0\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        tokenDecimals[token] = decimals_;\r\n        supportedTokenList.push(token);\r\n\r\n        emit TokenAdded(token, maxDepositAmount, liquidationPenalty);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Remove a supported token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     */\r\n    function removeSupportedToken(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[token].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Check no active deposits\r\n        if (supportedTokens[token].totalDeposited > 0) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token].isSupported = false;\r\n\r\n        // Remove from list\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < supportedTokenList.length; i++) {\r\n            if (supportedTokenList[i] == token) {\r\n                supportedTokenList[i] = supportedTokenList[\r\n                    supportedTokenList.length - 1\r\n                ];\r\n                supportedTokenList.pop();\r\n                break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit TokenRemoved(token);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Update token configuration\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param maxDepositAmount New max deposit amount\r\n     * @param liquidationPenalty New liquidation penalty\r\n     */\r\n    function updateTokenConfig(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[token].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token].maxDepositAmount = maxDepositAmount;\r\n        supportedTokens[token].liquidationPenalty = liquidationPenalty;\r\n\r\n        emit TokenConfigUpdated(token, maxDepositAmount, liquidationPenalty);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Deposit collateral for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param tokenAddress The address of the collateral address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 depositId) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[tokenAddress].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n        if (amount == 0) revert CollateralManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        TokenInfo storage tokenInfo = supportedTokens[tokenAddress];\r\n\r\n        // Check max deposit\r\n        if (amount > tokenInfo.maxDepositAmount) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__MaxDepositExceeded();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        depositId = nextDepositId++;\r\n\r\n        deposits[depositId] = CollateralDeposit({\r\n            depositId: depositId,\r\n            depositor: msg.sender,\r\n            tokenAddress: tokenAddress,\r\n            amount: amount,\r\n            loanId: loanId,\r\n            isLocked: false,\r\n            depositTimestamp: block.timestamp,\r\n            lockedTimestamp: 0\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        loanToDepositIds[loanId].push(depositId);\r\n        userDepositIds[msg.sender].push(depositId);\r\n\r\n        tokenInfo.totalDeposited += amount;\r\n\r\n        // Transfer tokens from user to this contract\r\n        IERC20(tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            address(this),\r\n            amount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralDeposited(\r\n            depositId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            tokenAddress,\r\n            amount,\r\n            block.timestamp\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return depositId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Withdraw unlocked collateral\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit to withdraw\r\n     */\r\n    function withdrawCollateral(uint256 depositId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (deposit.depositor != msg.sender)\r\n            revert CollateralManager__UnauthorizedWithdrawal();\r\n        if (deposit.isLocked) revert CollateralManager__DepositLocked();\r\n\r\n        address token = deposit.tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 amount = deposit.amount;\r\n        address depositor = deposit.depositor;\r\n\r\n        // Update state\r\n        supportedTokens[token].totalDeposited -= amount;\r\n        delete deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        // Transfer tokens back to user\r\n        IERC20(token).safeTransfer(depositor, amount);\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralWithdrawn(depositId, depositor, token, amount);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Lock collateral when loan becomes active (called by LendingPool)\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit to lock\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     */\r\n    function lockCollateral(\r\n        uint256 depositId,\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (deposit.isLocked) revert CollateralManager__DepositLocked();\r\n        if (deposit.loanId != loanId) revert CollateralManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        deposit.isLocked = true;\r\n        deposit.lockedTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralLocked(\r\n            depositId,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n            deposit.amount,\r\n            block.timestamp\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Unlock collateral after successful repayment (called by LendingPool)\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit to unlock\r\n     */\r\n    function unlockCollateral(\r\n        uint256 depositId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (!deposit.isLocked) revert CollateralManager__DepositNotLocked();\r\n\r\n        deposit.isLocked = false;\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralUnlocked(\r\n            depositId,\r\n            deposit.loanId,\r\n            deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n            deposit.amount\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Liquidate collateral for a defaulted loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the defaulted loan\r\n     * @param loanAmount The outstanding loan amount in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     * @param lender The address of the lender to receive funds\r\n     * @return recoveredAmount The amount recovered from liquidation in USD\r\n     */\r\n    function liquidateCollateral(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount,\r\n        address lender\r\n    )\r\n        external\r\n        onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE)\r\n        nonReentrant\r\n        returns (uint256 recoveredAmount)\r\n    {\r\n        if (lender == address(0)) revert CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n\r\n        uint256[] memory depositIds = loanToDepositIds[loanId];\r\n        if (depositIds.length == 0)\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n\r\n        uint256 totalRecovered = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n\r\n            if (!deposit.isLocked) continue;\r\n\r\n            // Check grace period\r\n            if (\r\n                block.timestamp <\r\n                deposit.lockedTimestamp + );\r\n\r\n            // Apply liquidation penalty\r\n            uint256 penalty = supportedTokens[deposit.tokenAddress]\r\n                .liquidationPenalty;\r\n            uint256 MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\r\nimport \"./ReputationManager.sol\";\r\nimport \"./LendingPool.sol\";\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * @title CoSigningManager\r\n * @notice Manages co-signing relationships where trusted users can vouch for borrowers\r\n * @dev Integrates with ReputationManager and LendingPool for reputation staking\r\n */\r\ncontract CoSigningManager is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    ReputationManager public immutable reputationManager;\r\n    LendingPool public immutable lendingPool;\r\n\r\n    // Counters\r\n    uint256 public nextRequestId = 1;\r\n    uint256 public nextRecordId = 1;\r\n\r\n    // Storage\r\n    mapping(uint256 => CoSigningRequest) public coSigningRequests;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => CoSigningRecord) public coSigningRecords;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) public loanCoSigners; // loanId      => recordIds[]\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userRequests; // borrower    => requestIds[]\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userCoSignings; // coSigner    => recordIds[]\r\n\r\n    // \u2190 NEW: index accepted records by their originating loan offer so that\r\n    //   LendingPool.cancelLoanOffer can find and reverse them.\r\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) public offerToRecords; // loanOfferId => recordIds[]\r\n\r\n    // Co-signing limits\r\n    uint256 public constant MIN_COSIGNER_REPUTATION = 50; //to be changed back to 200\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_BONUS_PERCENTAGE = 50;\r\n    uint256 public constant COOLDOWN_PERIOD = 30 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_COSIGNERS_PER_LOAN = 3;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct CoSigningRequest {\r\n        uint256 requestId;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId;\r\n        uint256 requestedBonus;\r\n        bool isActive;\r\n        uint256 createdAt;\r\n        string message;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct CoSigningRecord {\r\n        uint256 recordId;\r\n        address coSigner;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n        uint256 loanId;\r\n        uint256 reputationStaked;\r\n        uint256 bonusProvided;\r\n        uint256 coSignTimestamp;\r\n        bool isActive;\r\n        bool loanCompleted;\r\n        bool borrowerDefaulted;\r\n        bool wasCancelled;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningRequestCreated(\r\n        uint256 indexed requestId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanOfferId,\r\n        uint256 requestedBonus,\r\n        string message\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningRequestCancelled(\r\n        uint256 indexed requestId,\r\n        address indexed borrower\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningCompleted(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 bonusProvided\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningReleased(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        bool successfulRepayment\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSignerPenalized(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 penaltyAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSignerRewarded(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 rewardAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // \u2190 NEW\r\n    event CoSigningRecordCancelled(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error CoSigningManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RequestNotFound();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RequestNotActive();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__InsufficientReputation();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__MaxCoSignersReached();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__CannotCoSignSelf();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__LoanNotFound();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__InvalidBonus();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RecordAlreadyLinked();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor(address _reputationManager, address _lendingPool) {\r\n        if (_reputationManager == address(0) || _lendingPool == address(0)) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        reputationManager = ReputationManager(_reputationManager);\r\n        lendingPool = LendingPool(_lendingPool);\r\n\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions - Request Management ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Create a co-signing request for a loan offer\r\n     * @param loanOfferId The ID of the loan offer\r\n     * @param requestedBonus Stored for display only \u2014 has no on-chain effect\r\n     * @param message Optional message to potential co-signers\r\n     * @return requestId The ID of the created request\r\n     */\r\n    function createCoSigningRequest(\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId,\r\n        uint256 requestedBonus,\r\n        string calldata message\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 requestId) {\r\n        if (requestedBonus == 0) revert CoSigningManager__InvalidBonus();\r\n\r\n        LendingPool.LoanOffer memory offer = lendingPool.getLoanOffer(\r\n            loanOfferId\r\n        );\r\n        if (offer.creator == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__LoanNotFound();\r\n\r\n        requestId = nextRequestId++;\r\n\r\n        coSigningRequests[requestId] = CoSigningRequest({\r\n            requestId: requestId,\r\n            borrower: msg.sender,\r\n            loanOfferId: loanOfferId,\r\n            requestedBonus: requestedBonus,\r\n            isActive: true,\r\n            createdAt: block.timestamp,\r\n            message: message\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userRequests[msg.sender].push(requestId);\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningRequestCreated(\r\n            requestId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            loanOfferId,\r\n            requestedBonus,\r\n            message\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return requestId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Cancel a co-signing REQUEST (before anyone has accepted it).\r\n     * @dev No reputation has been applied yet at this stage \u2014 no reversal needed.\r\n     *      Only the borrower who created the request can call this.\r\n     * @param requestId The ID of the request to cancel\r\n     */\r\n    function cancelCoSigningRequest(uint256 requestId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRequest storage request = coSigningRequests[requestId];\r\n\r\n        if (request.borrower == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotFound();\r\n        if (!request.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotActive();\r\n        if (request.borrower != msg.sender)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n\r\n        request.isActive = false;\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningRequestCancelled(requestId, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Accept a co-signing request and stake reputation\r\n     * @param requestId The ID of the request to accept\r\n     * @return recordId The ID of the co-signing record\r\n     */\r\n    function acceptCoSigningRequest(\r\n        uint256 requestId\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 recordId) {\r\n        CoSigningRequest storage request = coSigningRequests[requestId];\r\n\r\n        if (request.borrower == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotFound();\r\n        if (!request.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotActive();\r\n        if (msg.sender == request.borrower)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__CannotCoSignSelf();\r\n\r\n        uint256 coSignerReputation = reputationManager.getReputationScore(\r\n            msg.sender\r\n        );\r\n        if (coSignerReputation < MIN_COSIGNER_REPUTATION) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__InsufficientReputation();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Actual bonus determined by ReputationManager \u2014 requestedBonus is ignored here\r\n        uint256 bonusProvided = reputationManager.addCoSigningBonus(\r\n            request.borrower,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            coSignerReputation\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        recordId = nextRecordId++;\r\n\r\n        coSigningRecords[recordId] = CoSigningRecord({\r\n            recordId: recordId,\r\n            coSigner: msg.sender,\r\n            borrower: request.borrower,\r\n            loanId: 0, // linked to actual loan later via addCoSignerToLoan\r\n            reputationStaked: coSignerReputation,\r\n            bonusProvided: bonusProvided,\r\n            coSignTimestamp: block.timestamp,\r\n            isActive: true,\r\n            loanCompleted: false,\r\n            borrowerDefaulted: false,\r\n            wasCancelled: false\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userCoSignings[msg.sender].push(recordId);\r\n\r\n        // \u2190 NEW: populate offerToRecords so LendingPool.cancelLoanOffer can\r\n        //   look up this record by offer ID and reverse the bonus if needed.\r\n        offerToRecords[request.loanOfferId].push(recordId);\r\n\r\n        // Deactivate the request \u2014 one co-signer per request\r\n        request.isActive = false;\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningCompleted(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            request.borrower,\r\n            0,\r\n            bonusProvided\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return recordId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Cancel an active co-signing RECORD when the underlying loan offer\r\n     *         is cancelled by the borrower before a lender accepts it.\r\n     * @dev Reverses the reputation bonus given to the borrower and decrements\r\n     *      the co-signer's active count. Called by LendingPool (which holds\r\n     *      DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) or directly by the borrower.\r\n     * @param recordId The ID of the co-signing record to cancel\r\n     */\r\n    function cancelCoSigningRecord(uint256 recordId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRecord storage record = coSigningRecords[recordId];\r\n\r\n        if (record.coSigner == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n        if (!record.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n\r\n        // Only the borrower or LendingPool (admin) can cancel\r\n        if (\r\n            msg.sender != record.borrower &&\r\n            !hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender)\r\n        ) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        record.isActive = false;\r\n        record.loanCompleted = true;\r\n        record.wasCancelled = true;\r\n\r\n        // Reverse the reputation bonus given to the borrower\r\n        if (record.bonusProvided > 0) {\r\n            reputationManager.removeCoSigningBonus(\r\n                record.borrower,\r\n                record.bonusProvided\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Decrement the co-signer's active co-sign count\r\n        reputationManager.decrementActiveCoSigns(record.coSigner);\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningRecordCancelled(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower\r\n        );\r\n        emit CoSigningReleased(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            false\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Add co-signer to an active loan (called by borrower after loan is matched)\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the matched loan\r\n     * @param coSignRecordId The ID of the co-signing record\r\n     */\r\n    function addCoSignerToLoan(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 coSignRecordId\r\n    ) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRecord storage record = coSigningRecords[coSignRecordId];\r\n\r\n        if (record.coSigner == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n        if (!record.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n\r\n        LendingPool.Loan memory loan = lendingPool.getLoan(loanId);\r\n        if (loan.borrower == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__LoanNotFound();\r\n        if (loan.borrower != record.borrower)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n\r\n        if (loanCoSigners[loanId].length >= MAX_COSIGNERS_PER_LOAN) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__MaxCoSignersReached();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        record.loanId = loanId;\r\n        loanCoSigners[loanId].push(coSignRecordId);\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningCompleted(\r\n            coSignRecordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            record.bonusProvided\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Release co-signing after loan completion\r\n     * @param recordId The ID of the co-signing record\r\n     * @param successfulRepayment true = repaid, false = defaulted\r\n     */\r\n    function releaseCoSigning(\r\n        uint256 recordId,\r\n        bool successfulRepayment\r\n    ) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRecord storage record = coSigningRecords[recordId];\r\n\r\n        if (record.coSigner == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n        if (!record.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n\r\n        record.isActive = false;\r\n        record.loanCompleted = true;\r\n\r\n        // FIX: Always clear the borrower's co-signing bonus on release\r\n        reputationManager.clearCoSigningBonus(record.borrower);\r\n\r\n        if (successfulRepayment) {\r\n            reputationManager.rewardCoSigner(record.coSigner, record.borrower);\r\n            emit CoSignerRewarded(\r\n                recordId,\r\n                record.coSigner,\r\n                record.borrower,\r\n                10\r\n            );\r\n        } else {\r\n            record.borrowerDefaulted = true;\r\n            reputationManager.penalizeCoSigner(\r\n                record.coSigner,\r\n                record.borrower,\r\n                record.reputationStaked\r\n            );\r\n            emit CoSignerPenalized(\r\n                recordId,\r\n                record.coSigner,\r\n                record.borrower,\r\n                record.reputationStaked / 3\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningReleased(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            successfulRepayment\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Link a co-signing record to a matched loan (called by LendingPool)\r\n     * @param recordId The co-signing record ID\r\n     * @param loanId The matched loan ID\r\n     */\r\n    function linkRecordToLoan(\r\n        uint256 recordId,\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRecord storage record = coSigningRecords[recordId];\r\n\r\n        if (record.coSigner == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n        if (!record.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n        if (record.loanId != 0) revert CoSigningManager__RecordAlreadyLinked(); // NEW ERROR\r\n\r\n        record.loanId = loanId;\r\n        loanCoSigners[loanId].push(recordId);\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningCompleted(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            record.bonusProvided\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ View Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all record IDs for a given loan offer.\r\n     * @dev Populated in acceptCoSigningRequest. Used by LendingPool.cancelLoanOffer.\r\n     */\r\n    function getRecordsByOffer(\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return offerToRecords[loanOfferId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Calculate co-signing bonus preview for a borrower/coSigner pair\r\n     */\r\n    function calculateCoSigningBonus(\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        address coSigner\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 bonus) {\r\n        uint256 coSignerReputation = reputationManager.getReputationScore(\r\n            coSigner\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 baseBonus = (coSignerReputation * MAX_BONUS_PERCENTAGE) / 100;\r\n        uint256 coSignCount = reputationManager.getCoSignCount(\r\n            coSigner,\r\n            borrower\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        if (coSignCount == 0) {\r\n            return baseBonus;\r\n        } else if (coSignCount == 1) {\r\n            return (baseBonus * 60) / 100;\r\n        } else if (coSignCount == 2) {\r\n            return (baseBonus * 30) / 100;\r\n        } else {\r\n            return (baseBonus * 10) / 100;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get co-signing record details\r\n     */\r\n    function getCoSigningRecord(\r\n        uint256 recordId\r\n    ) external view returns (CoSigningRecord memory) {\r\n        return coSigningRecords[recordId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get co-signing request details\r\n     */\r\n    function getCoSigningRequest(\r\n        uint256 requestId\r\n    ) external view returns (CoSigningRequest memory) {\r\n        return coSigningRequests[requestId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all request IDs for a borrower\r\n     */\r\n    function getCoSigningRequests(\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return userRequests[borrower];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all active requests for a borrower as full structs\r\n     */\r\n    function getActiveCoSigningRequests(\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external view returns (CoSigningRequest[] memory) {\r\n        uint256[] memory requestIds = userRequests[borrower];\r\n        uint256 activeCount = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < requestIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRequests[requestIds[i]].isActive) activeCount++;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        CoSigningRequest[] memory activeRequests = new CoSigningRequest[](\r\n            activeCount\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 index = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < requestIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRequests[requestIds[i]].isActive) {\r\n                activeRequests[index++] = coSigningRequests[requestIds[i]];\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return activeRequests;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all record IDs for a co-signer\r\n     */\r\n    function getUserCoSignings(\r\n        address coSigner\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return userCoSignings[coSigner];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all active records for a user as full structs\r\n     */\r\n    function getActiveCoSignings(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (CoSigningRecord[] memory) {\r\n        uint256[] memory recordIds = userCoSignings[user];\r\n        uint256 activeCount = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]].isActive) activeCount++;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        CoSigningRecord[] memory activeRecords = new CoSigningRecord[](\r\n            activeCount\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 index = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]].isActive) {\r\n                activeRecords[index++] = coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]];\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return activeRecords;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if diminishing returns apply for a pair\r\n     */\r\n    function hasDiminishingReturns(\r\n        address coSigner,\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        return reputationManager.hasDiminishingReturns(coSigner, borrower);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get co-signing statistics for a user\r\n     */\r\n    function getCoSigningStats(\r\n        address user\r\n    )\r\n        external\r\n        view\r\n        returns (\r\n            uint256 totalCoSignings,\r\n            uint256 activeCoSignings,\r\n            uint256 successfulCoSignings,\r\n            uint256 defaultedCoSignings\r\n        )\r\n    {\r\n        uint256[] memory recordIds = userCoSignings[user];\r\n        totalCoSignings = recordIds.length;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n            CoSigningRecord memory record = coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]];\r\n            if (record.isActive) {\r\n                activeCoSignings++;\r\n            } else if (record.loanCompleted) {\r\n                if (record.borrowerDefaulted) {\r\n                    defaultedCoSignings++;\r\n                } else {\r\n                    successfulCoSignings++;\r\n                }\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return (\r\n            totalCoSignings,\r\n            activeCoSignings,\r\n            successfulCoSignings,\r\n            defaultedCoSignings\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all open co-signing requests across all borrowers (for the discovery page)\r\n     */\r\n    function getAllOpenRequests()\r\n        external\r\n        view\r\n        returns (CoSigningRequest[] memory)\r\n    {\r\n        uint256 totalRequests = nextRequestId - 1;\r\n        uint256 openCount = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= totalRequests; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRequests[i].isActive) openCount++;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        CoSigningRequest[] memory openRequests = new CoSigningRequest[](\r\n            openCount\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 index = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= totalRequests; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRequests[i].isActive) {\r\n                openRequests[index++] = coSigningRequests[i];\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return openRequests;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all co-signing record IDs for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The loan ID\r\n     * @return Array of co-signing record IDs\r\n     */\r\n    function getLoanCoSigners(\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return loanCoSigners[loanId];\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0x62d8502c51b6798c04fad75cb4b27e6dd1bf255395bd91b674b64e15ef7563f0","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/CollateralManager.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\r\nimport \"./PriceOracle.sol\";\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * @title CollateralManager\r\n * @notice Manages collateral deposits, withdrawals, and liquidations for lending platform\r\n * @dev Integrates with PriceOracle for real-time collateral valuation\r\n */\r\ncontract CollateralManager is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\r\n\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    bytes32 public constant LENDING_POOL_ROLE = keccak256(\"LENDING_POOL_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant LIQUIDATOR_ROLE = keccak256(\"LIQUIDATOR_ROLE\");\r\n\r\n    PriceOracle public immutable priceOracle;\r\n\r\n    // Collateral deposits\r\n    mapping(uint256 => CollateralDeposit) public deposits;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) public loanToDepositIds; // loanId => depositIds[]\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userDepositIds; // user => depositIds[]\r\n\r\n    // Token information\r\n    mapping(address => TokenInfo) public supportedTokens;\r\n    mapping(address => uint8) public tokenDecimals;\r\n    address[] public supportedTokenList;\r\n\r\n    // Counters\r\n    uint256 public nextDepositId;\r\n\r\n    // Liquidation parameters\r\n    uint256 public constant LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD = 11000; // 110% (in basis points)\r\n    uint256 public constant MIN_COLLATERAL_RATIO = 12000; // 120% (in basis points)\r\n    uint256 public constant LIQUIDATION_BONUS = 500; // 5% bonus for liquidators\r\n    uint256 public constant BASIS_POINTS = 10000; // 100%\r\n\r\n    // Grace period before liquidation (to give borrower time to add collateral)\r\n    uint256 public constant LIQUIDATION_GRACE_PERIOD = 1 hours;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct CollateralDeposit {\r\n        uint256 depositId;\r\n        address depositor;\r\n        address tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 amount;\r\n        uint256 loanId;\r\n        bool isLocked;\r\n        uint256 depositTimestamp;\r\n        uint256 lockedTimestamp;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct TokenInfo {\r\n        bool isSupported;\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount; // Max amount that can be deposited\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty; // Penalty on liquidation (basis points)\r\n        uint256 totalDeposited; // Total amount currently deposited\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct CollateralValue {\r\n        address tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 amount;\r\n        uint256 valueInUSD;\r\n        uint256 lastUpdated;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event CollateralDeposited(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        address indexed depositor,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint256 timestamp\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralWithdrawn(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        address indexed depositor,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralLocked(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint256 timestamp\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralUnlocked(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralLiquidated(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        address liquidator,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint256 recoveredValue\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event TokenAdded(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event TokenRemoved(address indexed token);\r\n\r\n    event TokenConfigUpdated(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n    error CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n    error CollateralManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n    error CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n    error CollateralManager__DepositLocked();\r\n    error CollateralManager__DepositNotLocked();\r\n    error CollateralManager__UnauthorizedWithdrawal();\r\n    error CollateralManager__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n    error CollateralManager__CannotLiquidate();\r\n    error CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n    error CollateralManager__MaxDepositExceeded();\r\n    error CollateralManager__TransferFailed();\r\n    error CollateralManager__GracePeriodActive();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor(address _priceOracle) {\r\n        if (_priceOracle == address(0)) revert CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n\r\n        priceOracle = PriceOracle(_priceOracle);\r\n\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n        _grantRole(LIQUIDATOR_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n\r\n        nextDepositId = 1;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Add a supported collateral token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param decimals_ The token decimals\r\n     * @param maxDepositAmount Maximum deposit amount\r\n     * @param liquidationPenalty Liquidation penalty in basis points\r\n     */\r\n    function addSupportedToken(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint8 decimals_,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (token == address(0)) revert CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n        if (supportedTokens[token].isSupported)\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n\r\n        // Verify token is supported by price oracle\r\n        if (!priceOracle.isSupportedToken(token)) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token] = TokenInfo({\r\n            isSupported: true,\r\n            maxDepositAmount: maxDepositAmount,\r\n            liquidationPenalty: liquidationPenalty,\r\n            totalDeposited: 0\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        tokenDecimals[token] = decimals_;\r\n        supportedTokenList.push(token);\r\n\r\n        emit TokenAdded(token, maxDepositAmount, liquidationPenalty);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Remove a supported token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     */\r\n    function removeSupportedToken(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[token].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Check no active deposits\r\n        if (supportedTokens[token].totalDeposited > 0) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token].isSupported = false;\r\n\r\n        // Remove from list\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < supportedTokenList.length; i++) {\r\n            if (supportedTokenList[i] == token) {\r\n                supportedTokenList[i] = supportedTokenList[\r\n                    supportedTokenList.length - 1\r\n                ];\r\n                supportedTokenList.pop();\r\n                break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit TokenRemoved(token);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Update token configuration\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param maxDepositAmount New max deposit amount\r\n     * @param liquidationPenalty New liquidation penalty\r\n     */\r\n    function updateTokenConfig(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[token].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token].maxDepositAmount = maxDepositAmount;\r\n        supportedTokens[token].liquidationPenalty = liquidationPenalty;\r\n\r\n        emit TokenConfigUpdated(token, maxDepositAmount, liquidationPenalty);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Deposit collateral for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param tokenAddress The address of the collateral token\r\n     * @param amount The amount to deposit\r\n     * @return depositId The ID of the created deposit\r\n     */\r\n    function depositCollateral(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 depositId) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[tokenAddress].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n        if (amount == 0) revert CollateralManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        TokenInfo storage tokenInfo = supportedTokens[tokenAddress];\r\n\r\n        // Check max deposit\r\n        if (amount > tokenInfo.maxDepositAmount) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__MaxDepositExceeded();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        depositId = nextDepositId++;\r\n\r\n        deposits[depositId] = CollateralDeposit({\r\n            depositId: depositId,\r\n            depositor: msg.sender,\r\n            tokenAddress: tokenAddress,\r\n            amount: amount,\r\n            loanId: loanId,\r\n            isLocked: false,\r\n            depositTimestamp: block.timestamp,\r\n            lockedTimestamp: 0\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        loanToDepositIds[loanId].push(depositId);\r\n        userDepositIds[msg.sender].push(depositId);\r\n\r\n        tokenInfo.totalDeposited += amount;\r\n\r\n        // Transfer tokens from user to this contract\r\n        IERC20(tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            address(this),\r\n            amount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralDeposited(\r\n            depositId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            tokenAddress,\r\n            amount,\r\n            block.timestamp\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return depositId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Withdraw unlocked collateral\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit to withdraw\r\n     */\r\n    function withdrawCollateral(uint256 depositId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (deposit.depositor != msg.sender)\r\n            revert CollateralManager__UnauthorizedWithdrawal();\r\n        if (deposit.isLocked) revert CollateralManager__DepositLocked();\r\n\r\n        address token = deposit.tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 amount = deposit.amount;\r\n        address depositor = deposit.depositor;\r\n\r\n        // Update state\r\n        supportedTokens[token].totalDeposited -= amount;\r\n        delete deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        // Transfer tokens back to user\r\n        IERC20(token).safeTransfer(depositor, amount);\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralWithdrawn(depositId, depositor, token, amount);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Lock collateral when loan becomes active (called by LendingPool)\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit to lock\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     */\r\n    function lockCollateral(\r\n        uint256 depositId,\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (deposit.isLocked) revert CollateralManager__DepositLocked();\r\n        if (deposit.loanId != loanId) revert CollateralManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        deposit.isLocked = true;\r\n        deposit.lockedTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralLocked(\r\n            depositId,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n            deposit.amount,\r\n            block.timestamp\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Unlock collateral after successful repayment (called by LendingPool)\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit to unlock\r\n     */\r\n    function unlockCollateral(\r\n        uint256 depositId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (!deposit.isLocked) revert CollateralManager__DepositNotLocked();\r\n\r\n        deposit.isLocked = false;\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralUnlocked(\r\n            depositId,\r\n            deposit.loanId,\r\n            deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n            deposit.amount\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Liquidate collateral for a defaulted loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the defaulted loan\r\n     * @param loanAmount The outstanding loan amount in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     * @param lender The address of the lender to receive funds\r\n     * @return recoveredAmount The amount recovered from liquidation in USD\r\n     */\r\n    function liquidateCollateral(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount,\r\n        address lender\r\n    )\r\n        external\r\n        onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE)\r\n        nonReentrant\r\n        returns (uint256 recoveredAmount)\r\n    {\r\n        if (lender == address(0)) revert CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n\r\n        uint256[] memory depositIds = loanToDepositIds[loanId];\r\n        if (depositIds.length == 0)\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n\r\n        uint256 totalRecovered = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n\r\n            if (!deposit.isLocked) continue;\r\n\r\n            // Check grace period\r\n            if (\r\n                block.timestamp <\r\n                deposit.lockedTimestamp + LIQUIDATION_GRACE_PERIOD\r\n            ) {\r\n                revert CollateralManager__GracePeriodActive();\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Get collateral value\r\n            uint256 collateralValue = priceOracle.getTokenValueInUSD(\r\n                deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n                deposit.amount,\r\n                tokenDecimals[deposit.tokenAddress]\r\n            );\r\n\r\n            // Apply liquidation penalty\r\n            uint256 penalty = supportedTokens[deposit.tokenAddress]\r\n                .liquidationPenalty;\r\n            uint256 valueAfterPenalty = (collateralValue *\r\n                (BASIS_POINTS - penalty)) / BASIS_POINTS;\r\n\r\n            totalRecovered += valueAfterPenalty;\r\n\r\n            // Transfer collateral to lender\r\n            IERC20(deposit.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(lender, deposit.amount);\r\n\r\n            // Update state\r\n            supportedTokens[deposit.tokenAddress].totalDeposited -= deposit\r\n                .amount;\r\n\r\n            emit CollateralLiquidated(\r\n                depositIds[i],\r\n                loanId,\r\n                deposit.depositor,\r\n                lender,\r\n                deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n                deposit.amount,\r\n                valueAfterPenalty\r\n            );\r\n\r\n            // Clear deposit\r\n            delete deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Clear loan deposits\r\n        delete loanToDepositIds[loanId];\r\n\r\n        return totalRecovered;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the USD value of collateral for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @return valueInUSD The total collateral value in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     */\r\n    function getLoanCollateralValue(\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 valueInUSD) {\r\n        uint256[] memory depositIds = loanToDepositIds[loanId];\r\n        uint256 totalValue = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            CollateralDeposit memory deposit = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n\r\n            if (deposit.amount > 0) {\r\n                uint256 value = priceOracle.getTokenValueInUSD(\r\n                    deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n                    deposit.amount,\r\n                    tokenDecimals[deposit.tokenAddress]\r\n                );\r\n                totalValue += value;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return totalValue;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get collateral deposit details\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit\r\n     * @return deposit The collateral deposit struct\r\n     */\r\n    function getCollateralDeposit(\r\n        uint256 depositId\r\n    ) external view returns (CollateralDeposit memory) {\r\n        return deposits[depositId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all collateral deposits for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @return loanDeposits Array of collateral deposits\r\n     */\r\n    function getLoanCollateral(\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external view returns (CollateralDeposit[] memory) {\r\n        uint256[] memory depositIds = loanToDepositIds[loanId];\r\n        CollateralDeposit[] memory loanDeposits = new CollateralDeposit[](\r\n            depositIds.length\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            loanDeposits[i] = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return loanDeposits;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all deposits for a user\r\n     * @param user The user address\r\n     * @return userDeposits Array of user's deposits\r\n     */\r\n    function getUserDeposits(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (CollateralDeposit[] memory) {\r\n        uint256[] memory depositIds = userDepositIds[user];\r\n        CollateralDeposit[] memory userDeposits = new CollateralDeposit[](\r\n            depositIds.length\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            userDeposits[i] = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return userDeposits;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if collateral is sufficient for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param loanAmount The loan amount in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     * @param requiredRatio The required collateral ratio (basis points)\r\n     * @return isSufficient True if collateral is sufficient\r\n     */\r\n    function isCollateralSufficient(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount,\r\n        uint256 requiredRatio\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) return true;\r\n\r\n        uint256 collateralValue = this.getLoanCollateralValue(loanId);\r\n        uint256 actualRatio = (collateralValue * BASIS_POINTS) / loanAmount;\r\n\r\n        return actualRatio >= requiredRatio;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Calculate health factor for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param loanAmount The loan amount in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     * @return healthFactor The health factor (10000 = 100%)\r\n     */\r\n    function calculateHealthFactor(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 healthFactor) {\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) return type(uint256).max;\r\n\r\n        uint256 collateralValue = this.getLoanCollateralValue(loanId);\r\n        healthFactor = (collateralValue * BASIS_POINTS) / loanAmount;\r\n\r\n        return healthFactor;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if a loan is eligible for liquidation\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param loanAmount The loan amount in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     * @return canLiquidate True if loan can be liquidated\r\n     */\r\n    function canLiquidate(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) return false;\r\n\r\n        uint256 healthFactor = this.calculateHealthFactor(loanId, loanAmount);\r\n\r\n        // Can liquidate if health factor below threshold (110%)\r\n        return healthFactor < LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all supported collateral tokens\r\n     * @return tokens Array of supported token addresses\r\n     */\r\n    function getSupportedTokens() external view returns (address[] memory) {\r\n        return supportedTokenList;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get token information\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return tokenInfo The token info struct\r\n     */\r\n    function getTokenInfo(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external view returns (TokenInfo memory) {\r\n        return supportedTokens[token];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get detailed collateral value information\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param amount The token amount\r\n     * @return collateralValue Struct with value details\r\n     */\r\n    function getCollateralValueDetails(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    ) external view returns (CollateralValue memory) {\r\n        uint256 valueInUSD = priceOracle.getTokenValueInUSD(\r\n            token,\r\n            amount,\r\n            tokenDecimals[token]\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return\r\n            CollateralValue({\r\n                tokenAddress: token,\r\n                amount: amount,\r\n                valueInUSD: valueInUSD,\r\n                lastUpdated: block.timestamp\r\n            });\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0xab99fbb0548117617b48c5e270ae9e97968940342d5fba3c9a16cb97b0b8dacc","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/LendingPool.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\r\nimport \"./ReputationManager.sol\";\r\nimport \"./CollateralManager.sol\";\r\nimport \"./CoSigningManager.sol\";\r\nimport \"./LoanLogic.sol\";\r\nimport \"./ActiveOfferLib.sol\";\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * @title LendingPool\r\n * @notice Core P2P lending pool with reputation-based matching\r\n * @dev Integrates with ReputationManager, CollateralManager, and CoSigningManager\r\n */\r\ncontract LendingPool is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\r\n\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    ReputationManager public immutable reputationManager;\r\n    CollateralManager public immutable collateralManager;\r\n    CoSigningManager public coSigningManager; // \u2190 NEW: mutable so it can be set after deploy\r\n\r\n    // Counters\r\n    uint256 public nextOfferId = 1;\r\n    uint256
