public nextLoanId = 1;\r\n\r\n    // Storage\r\n    mapping(uint256 => LoanOffer) public loanOffers;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => Loan) public loans;\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userOffers;\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userLoans;\r\n\r\n    // Active offers lists\r\n    uint256[] public activeLenderOffers;\r\n    uint256[] public activeBorrowerRequests;\r\n\r\n    // Platform fee (in basis points)\r\n    uint256 public platformFeeRate = 100; // 1%\r\n    uint256 public constant BASIS_POINTS = 10000;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_PLATFORM_FEE = 500; // 5% max\r\n\r\n    // Loan constraints\r\n    uint256 public constant MIN_LOAN_DURATION = 1 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_LOAN_DURATION = 365 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_INTEREST_RATE = 5000; // 50%\r\n\r\n    uint256 public constant MIN_COLLATERAL_RATIO = 12000;\r\n\r\n    address public feeCollector;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Enums ============\r\n\r\n    enum LoanStatus {\r\n        PENDING,\r\n        ACTIVE,\r\n        REPAID,\r\n        DEFAULTED,\r\n        CANCELLED\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    enum LoanType {\r\n        LENDER_OFFER,\r\n        BORROW_REQUEST\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct LoanTerms {\r\n        address tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 principalAmount;\r\n        uint256 collateralAmount;\r\n        address collateralToken;\r\n        uint256 interestRate;\r\n        uint256 duration;\r\n        uint256 minReputation;\r\n        uint256 collateralRatio;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct LoanOffer {\r\n        uint256 offerId;\r\n        LoanType offerType;\r\n        address creator;\r\n        LoanTerms terms;\r\n        bool isActive;\r\n        uint256 createdAt;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct Loan {\r\n        uint256 loanId;\r\n        LoanType loanType;\r\n        address lender;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n        LoanTerms terms;\r\n        LoanStatus status;\r\n        uint256 startTime;\r\n        uint256 dueTime;\r\n        uint256 amountRepaid;\r\n        uint256 collateralDepositId;\r\n        bool hasCoSigner;\r\n        address coSigner;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event LoanOfferCreated(\r\n        uint256 indexed offerId,\r\n        address indexed creator,\r\n        LoanType offerType,\r\n        uint256 principalAmount,\r\n        uint256 interestRate,\r\n        uint256 duration\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event LoanOfferCancelled(uint256 indexed offerId, address indexed creator);\r\n\r\n    event LoanMatched(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        uint256 indexed offerId,\r\n        address indexed lender,\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        uint256 principalAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event LoanRepayment(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint256 remainingAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event LoanRepaid(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 totalRepaid\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event LoanDefaulted(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 unpaidAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralLiquidated(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 recoveredAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event PlatformFeeCollected(uint256 indexed loanId, uint256 feeAmount);\r\n\r\n    event PlatformFeeRateUpdated(uint256 oldRate, uint256 newRate);\r\n\r\n    // \u2190 NEW EVENT\r\n    event CoSigningManagerUpdated(\r\n        address indexed oldManager,\r\n        address indexed newManager\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidAmount();\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidDuration();\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidInterestRate();\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidCollateralRatio();\r\n    error LendingPool__OfferNotFound();\r\n    error LendingPool__OfferNotActive();\r\n    error LendingPool__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n    error LendingPool__InsufficientReputation();\r\n    error LendingPool__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n    error LendingPool__LoanNotActive();\r\n    error LendingPool__LoanNotOverdue();\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidRepaymentAmount();\r\n    error LendingPool__ZeroAddress();\r\n    error LendingPool__TransferFailed();\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidFeeRate();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor(\r\n        address _reputationManager,\r\n        address _collateralManager,\r\n        address _feeCollector\r\n    ) {\r\n        if (\r\n            _reputationManager == address(0) ||\r\n            _collateralManager == address(0) ||\r\n            _feeCollector == address(0)\r\n        ) {\r\n            revert LendingPool__ZeroAddress();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        reputationManager = ReputationManager(_reputationManager);\r\n        collateralManager = CollateralManager(_collateralManager);\r\n        feeCollector = _feeCollector;\r\n\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions - Offer Management ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Create a new loan offer or borrow request\r\n     * @param offerType Type of offer (LENDER_OFFER or BORROW_REQUEST)\r\n     * @param terms The loan terms\r\n     * @return offerId The ID of the created offer\r\n     */\r\n    function createLoanOffer(\r\n        LoanType offerType,\r\n        LoanTerms calldata terms\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 offerId) {\r\n        _validateLoanTerms(terms, offerType);\r\n\r\n        offerId = nextOfferId++;\r\n\r\n        loanOffers[offerId] = LoanOffer({\r\n            offerId: offerId,\r\n            offerType: offerType,\r\n            creator: msg.sender,\r\n            terms: terms,\r\n            isActive: true,\r\n            createdAt: block.timestamp\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userOffers[msg.sender].push(offerId);\r\n\r\n        if (offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            activeLenderOffers.push(offerId);\r\n\r\n            // Lender locks funds upfront\r\n            IERC20(terms.tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n                msg.sender,\r\n                address(this),\r\n                terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        } else {\r\n            activeBorrowerRequests.push(offerId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanOfferCreated(\r\n            offerId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            offerType,\r\n            terms.principalAmount,\r\n            terms.interestRate,\r\n            terms.duration\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return offerId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Cancel an active loan offer\r\n     * @dev Also cancels any accepted co-signing records linked to this offer,\r\n     *      reversing the reputation bonus given to the borrower.\r\n     * @param offerId The ID of the offer to cancel\r\n     */\r\n    function cancelLoanOffer(uint256 offerId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        LoanOffer storage offer = loanOffers[offerId];\r\n\r\n        if (offer.creator == address(0)) revert LendingPool__OfferNotFound();\r\n        if (!offer.isActive) revert LendingPool__OfferNotActive();\r\n        if (offer.creator != msg.sender)\r\n            revert LendingPool__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n\r\n        offer.isActive = false;\r\n\r\n        // Remove from active lists\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            ActiveOfferLib.remove(activeLenderOffers, offerId);\r\n        } else {\r\n            ActiveOfferLib.remove(activeBorrowerRequests, offerId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Return locked funds to lender\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(\r\n                msg.sender,\r\n                offer.terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // \u2190 NEW: cancel any active co-signing records for this offer so that\r\n        //   (a) the reputation bonus given to the borrower is reversed, and\r\n        //   (b) the co-signer's active count is decremented correctly.\r\n        if (address(coSigningManager) != address(0)) {\r\n            uint256[] memory recordIds = coSigningManager.getRecordsByOffer(\r\n                offerId\r\n            );\r\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n                CoSigningManager.CoSigningRecord\r\n                    memory record = coSigningManager.getCoSigningRecord(\r\n                        recordIds[i]\r\n                    );\r\n                if (record.isActive) {\r\n                    // cancelCoSigningRecord reverses the bonus and marks inactive\r\n                    coSigningManager.cancelCoSigningRecord(recordIds[i]);\r\n                }\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanOfferCancelled(offerId, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Accept a loan offer and create an active loan\r\n     * @param offerId The ID of the offer to accept\r\n     * @param collateralDepositId The ID of the collateral deposit (for borrowers)\r\n     * @return loanId The ID of the created loan\r\n     */\r\n    function acceptLoanOffer(\r\n        uint256 offerId,\r\n        uint256 collateralDepositId\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 loanId) {\r\n        LoanOffer storage offer = loanOffers[offerId];\r\n        if (offer.creator == address(0)) revert LendingPool__OfferNotFound();\r\n        if (!offer.isActive) revert LendingPool__OfferNotActive();\r\n\r\n        address lender;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            // Lender created the offer \u2014 msg.sender is the borrower\r\n            lender = offer.creator;\r\n            borrower = msg.sender;\r\n\r\n            // Enforce minimum reputation for borrower\r\n            if (\r\n                !reputationManager.meetsReputationRequirement(\r\n                    borrower,\r\n                    offer.terms.minReputation\r\n                )\r\n            ) {\r\n                revert LendingPool__InsufficientReputation();\r\n            }\r\n        } else {\r\n            // Borrower created the request \u2014 msg.sender is the lender\r\n            lender = msg.sender;\r\n            borrower = offer.creator;\r\n\r\n            // Lender provides funds now\r\n            IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n                lender,\r\n                address(this),\r\n                offer.terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Verify and lock collateral\r\n        if (offer.terms.collateralAmount > 0) {\r\n            bool sufficient = collateralManager.isCollateralSufficient(\r\n                collateralDepositId,\r\n                offer.terms.principalAmount,\r\n                offer.terms.collateralRatio\r\n            );\r\n\r\n            if (!sufficient) revert LendingPool__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n\r\n            collateralManager.lockCollateral(collateralDepositId, nextLoanId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Create the loan\r\n        loanId = nextLoanId++;\r\n\r\n        loans[loanId] = Loan({\r\n            loanId: loanId,\r\n            loanType: offer.offerType,\r\n            lender: lender,\r\n            borrower: borrower,\r\n            terms: offer.terms,\r\n            status: LoanStatus.ACTIVE,\r\n            startTime: block.timestamp,\r\n            dueTime: block.timestamp + offer.terms.duration,\r\n            amountRepaid: 0,\r\n            collateralDepositId: collateralDepositId,\r\n            hasCoSigner: false,\r\n            coSigner: address(0)\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userLoans[lender].push(loanId);\r\n        userLoans[borrower].push(loanId);\r\n\r\n        if (address(coSigningManager) != address(0)) {\r\n            uint256[] memory recordIds = coSigningManager.getRecordsByOffer(\r\n                offerId\r\n            );\r\n\r\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n                CoSigningManager.CoSigningRecord\r\n                    memory record = coSigningManager.getCoSigningRecord(\r\n                        recordIds[i]\r\n                    );\r\n\r\n                if (record.isActive && !record.wasCancelled) {\r\n                    // Link this record to the newly created loan\r\n                    coSigningManager.linkRecordToLoan(recordIds[i], loanId);\r\n\r\n                    // Update loan struct to reflect co-signer\r\n                    loans[loanId].hasCoSigner = true;\r\n                    loans[loanId].coSigner = record.coSigner;\r\n\r\n                    break; // Only one co-signer per loan for now\r\n                }\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Deactivate offer and remove from active list\r\n        offer.isActive = false;\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            ActiveOfferLib.remove(activeLenderOffers, offerId);\r\n        } else {\r\n            ActiveOfferLib.remove(activeBorrowerRequests, offerId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Transfer principal to borrower (minus platform fee)\r\n        uint256 platformFee = (offer.terms.principalAmount * platformFeeRate) /\r\n            BASIS_POINTS;\r\n        uint256 amountToBorrower = offer.terms.principalAmount - platformFee;\r\n\r\n        IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(\r\n            borrower,\r\n            amountToBorrower\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        if (platformFee > 0) {\r\n            IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(\r\n                feeCollector,\r\n                platformFee\r\n            );\r\n            emit PlatformFeeCollected(loanId, platformFee);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanMatched(\r\n            loanId,\r\n            offerId,\r\n            lender,\r\n            borrower,\r\n            offer.terms.principalAmount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return loanId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions - Loan Management ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Repay an active loan (partial or full)\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param amount The amount to repay\r\n     */\r\n    function repayLoan(uint256 loanId, uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {\r\n        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];\r\n\r\n        if (loan.status != LoanStatus.ACTIVE)\r\n            revert LendingPool__LoanNotActive();\r\n        if (amount == 0) revert LendingPool__InvalidRepaymentAmount();\r\n\r\n        uint256 amountDue = LoanLogic.calculateAmountDue(\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount,\r\n            loan.terms.interestRate\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 remainingAmount = amountDue - loan.amountRepaid;\r\n\r\n        if (amount > remainingAmount) {\r\n            amount = remainingAmount;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        loan.amountRepaid += amount;\r\n\r\n        // Transfer repayment from borrower to lender\r\n        IERC20(loan.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            loan.lender,\r\n            amount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        emit LoanRepayment(\r\n            loanId,\r\n            loan.borrower,\r\n            amount,\r\n            remainingAmount - amount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Check if fully repaid\r\n        if (loan.amountRepaid >= amountDue) {\r\n            _completeLoanRepayment(loanId);\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Liquidate a defaulted loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     */\r\n    function liquidateLoan(uint256 loanId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];\r\n\r\n        if (loan.status != LoanStatus.ACTIVE)\r\n            revert LendingPool__LoanNotActive();\r\n        if (block.timestamp <= loan.dueTime)\r\n            revert LendingPool__LoanNotOverdue();\r\n\r\n        uint256 amountDue = LoanLogic.calculateAmountDue(\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount,\r\n            loan.terms.interestRate\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 unpaidAmount = amountDue - loan.amountRepaid;\r\n\r\n        // Liquidate collateral\r\n        uint256 recoveredAmount = 0;\r\n        if (loan.terms.collateralAmount > 0) {\r\n            recoveredAmount = collateralManager.liquidateCollateral(\r\n                loanId,\r\n                unpaidAmount,\r\n                loan.lender\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        loan.status = LoanStatus.DEFAULTED;\r\n\r\n        // Apply reputation penalty to borrower\r\n        reputationManager.recordDefault(\r\n            loan.borrower,\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Penalize co-signer if one exists\r\n        if (loan.hasCoSigner) {\r\n            reputationManager.penalizeCoSigner(\r\n                loan.coSigner,\r\n                loan.borrower,\r\n                loan.terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        if (loan.hasCoSigner && address(coSigningManager) != address(0)) {\r\n            uint256[] memory recordIds = coSigningManager.getLoanCoSigners(\r\n                loanId\r\n            );\r\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n                coSigningManager.releaseCoSigning(recordIds[i], false); // false = defaulted\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanDefaulted(loanId, loan.borrower, unpaidAmount);\r\n        emit CollateralLiquidated(loanId, loan.borrower, recoveredAmount);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ View Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if a loan is past due\r\n     */\r\n    function isLoanOverdue(uint256 loanId) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        Loan memory loan = loans[loanId];\r\n        if (loan.status != LoanStatus.ACTIVE) return false;\r\n        return block.timestamp > loan.dueTime;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get loan details\r\n     */\r\n    function getLoan(uint256 loanId) external view returns (Loan memory) {\r\n        return loans[loanId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get loan offer details\r\n     */\r\n    function getLoanOffer(\r\n        uint256 offerId\r\n    ) external view returns (LoanOffer memory) {\r\n        return loanOffers[offerId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getActiveLenderOfferIds()\r\n        external\r\n        view\r\n        returns (uint256[] memory)\r\n    {\r\n        return activeLenderOffers;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getActiveBorrowerRequestIds()\r\n        external\r\n        view\r\n        returns (uint256[] memory)\r\n    {\r\n        return activeBorrowerRequests;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all loans for a user (as lender or borrower)\r\n     */\r\n    function getUserLoans(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return userLoans[user];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get user's loan offers\r\n     */\r\n    function getUserOffers(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return userOffers[user];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the next loan ID (for counting total loans)\r\n     */\r\n    function getNextLoanId() external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return nextLoanId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the next offer ID (for counting total offers)\r\n     */\r\n    function getNextOfferId() external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return nextOfferId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the platform fee rate\r\n     */\r\n    function getPlatformFeeRate() external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return platformFeeRate;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the basis points constant\r\n     */\r\n    function getBasisPoints() external pure returns (uint256) {\r\n        return BASIS_POINTS;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Admin Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Update platform fee rate\r\n     * @param newFeeRate New fee rate in basis points\r\n     */\r\n    function setPlatformFeeRate(\r\n        uint256 newFeeRate\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (newFeeRate > MAX_PLATFORM_FEE) revert LendingPool__InvalidFeeRate();\r\n\r\n        uint256 oldRate = platformFeeRate;\r\n        platformFeeRate = newFeeRate;\r\n\r\n        emit PlatformFeeRateUpdated(oldRate, newFeeRate);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Update fee collector address\r\n     * @param newFeeCollector New fee collector address\r\n     */\r\n    function setFeeCollector(\r\n        address newFeeCollector\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (newFeeCollector == address(0)) revert LendingPool__ZeroAddress();\r\n        feeCollector = newFeeCollector;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Set the CoSigningManager address\r\n     * @dev Called once after both contracts are deployed. Can be updated by admin.\r\n     * @param _coSigningManager Address of the deployed CoSigningManager\r\n     */\r\n    function setCoSigningManager(\r\n        address _coSigningManager\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (_coSigningManager == address(0)) revert LendingPool__ZeroAddress();\r\n        address old = address(coSigningManager);\r\n        coSigningManager = CoSigningManager(_coSigningManager);\r\n        emit CoSigningManagerUpdated(old, _coSigningManager);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Internal Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Complete loan repayment and unlock collateral\r\n     */\r\n    function _completeLoanRepayment(uint256 loanId) internal {\r\n        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];\r\n\r\n        loan.status = LoanStatus.REPAID;\r\n\r\n        // Unlock collateral\r\n        if (loan.terms.collateralAmount > 0) {\r\n            collateralManager.unlockCollateral(loan.collateralDepositId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Update borrower reputation\r\n        reputationManager.recordSuccessfulRepayment(\r\n            loan.borrower,\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Update lender reputation\r\n        reputationManager.recordSuccessfulRepayment(\r\n            loan.lender,\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Reward co-signer if one exists\r\n        if (loan.hasCoSigner) {\r\n            reputationManager.rewardCoSigner(loan.coSigner, loan.borrower);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        if (loan.hasCoSigner && address(coSigningManager) != address(0)) {\r\n            // Find the record ID(s) for this loan\r\n            uint256[] memory recordIds = coSigningManager.getLoanCoSigners(\r\n                loanId\r\n            );\r\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n                coSigningManager.releaseCoSigning(recordIds[i], true); // true = successful\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanRepaid(loanId, loan.borrower, loan.amountRepaid);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Validate loan terms\r\n     */\r\n    function _validateLoanTerms(\r\n        LoanTerms calldata terms,\r\n        LoanType offerType\r\n    ) internal pure {\r\n        if (terms.principalAmount == 0) revert LendingPool__InvalidAmount();\r\n        if (\r\n            terms.duration < MIN_LOAN_DURATION ||\r\n            terms.duration > MAX_LOAN_DURATION\r\n        ) revert LendingPool__InvalidDuration();\r\n        if (terms.interestRate > MAX_INTEREST_RATE)\r\n            revert LendingPool__InvalidInterestRate();\r\n\r\n        if (offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            // Lender sets the ratio as a requirement for the borrower.\r\n            // A ratio of 0 means uncollateralized; otherwise enforce the floor.\r\n            if (\r\n                terms.collateralRatio != 0 &&\r\n                terms.collateralRatio < MIN_COLLATERAL_RATIO\r\n            ) revert LendingPool__InvalidCollateralRatio();\r\n        } else {\r\n            // Borrower request: they pre-deposit collateral themselves.\r\n            // If they specify an amount, the ratio must meet the floor.\r\n            // If no collateral, ratio must also be 0.\r\n            if (terms.collateralAmount > 0) {\r\n                if (terms.collateralRatio < MIN_COLLATERAL_RATIO)\r\n                    revert LendingPool__InvalidCollateralRatio();\r\n            } else {\r\n                if (terms.collateralRatio != 0)\r\n                    revert LendingPool__InvalidCollateralRatio();\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Remove offer from active list\r\n     */\r\n    function _removeFromActiveList(\r\n        uint256 offerId,\r\n        LoanType offerType\r\n    ) internal {\r\n        uint256[] storage activeList = offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER\r\n            ? activeLenderOffers\r\n            : activeBorrowerRequests;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < activeList.length; i++) {\r\n            if (activeList[i] == offerId) {\r\n                activeList[i] = activeList[activeList.length - 1];\r\n                activeList.pop();\r\n                break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0x0dc90c13c8fd0d2c2cbda37205c76ddab7717d04ceec6f1415fbe8ff1f9cf5e4","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/LoanLogic.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nlibrary LoanLogic {\r\n    uint256 internal constant BASIS_POINTS = 10000;\r\n\r\n    function calculateAmountDue(\r\n        uint256 principal,\r\n        uint256 interestRate\r\n    ) internal pure returns (uint256) {\r\n        return principal + (principal * interestRate) / BASIS_POINTS;\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0x010dcac8a75869a5dfdde424cc73ee767d346716728b4427912496c615e68677","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/PriceOracle.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@chainlink/contracts/src/v0.8/shared/interfaces/AggregatorV3Interface.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * @title PriceOracle\r\n * @notice Wrapper contract for Chainlink price feeds\r\n * @dev Provides unified interface for getting token prices in USD\r\n */\r\ncontract PriceOracle is Ownable {\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    // Mapping from token address to Chainlink price feed\r\n    mapping(address => AggregatorV3Interface) public priceFeeds;\r\n\r\n    // Mapping to track supported tokens\r\n    mapping(address => bool) public isSupportedToken;\r\n\r\n    // Array of all supported tokens\r\n    address[] public supportedTokens;\r\n\r\n    // Stale price threshold (default: 1 hour)\r\n    uint256 public stalePriceThreshold = 1 hours;\r\n\r\n    // Price deviation threshold for additional validation (in basis points)\r\n    // e.g., 5000 = 50% deviation allowed\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_PRICE_DEVIATION = 5000; // 50%\r\n\r\n    // Decimals for USD price (standardized to 18 decimals)\r\n    uint8 public constant PRICE_DECIMALS = 18;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct PriceData {\r\n        uint256 price; // Price in USD (18 decimals)\r\n        uint256 timestamp; // When price was updated\r\n        uint80 roundId; // Chainlink round ID\r\n        bool isValid; // Whether price is valid\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event PriceFeedUpdated(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        address indexed priceFeed,\r\n        string tokenSymbol\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event PriceFeedRemoved(address indexed token);\r\n\r\n    event PriceRetrieved(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        uint256 price,\r\n        uint256 timestamp\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event StalePriceThresholdUpdated(\r\n        uint256 oldThreshold,\r\n        uint256 newThreshold\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event PriceValidationFailed(address indexed token, string reason);\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error PriceOracle__InvalidPriceFeed();\r\n    error PriceOracle__PriceFeedNotSet();\r\n    error PriceOracle__StalePrice(uint256 timeSinceUpdate);\r\n    error PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n    error PriceOracle__InvalidRoundData();\r\n    error PriceOracle__TokenAlreadySupported();\r\n    error PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n    error PriceOracle__InvalidThreshold();\r\n    error PriceOracle__ZeroAddress();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor() Ownable() {}\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Set or update price feed for a token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param priceFeed The Chainlink price feed address\r\n     * @param tokenSymbol The token symbol (for events)\r\n     */\r\n    function setPriceFeed(\r\n        address token,\r\n        address priceFeed,\r\n        string calldata tokenSymbol\r\n    ) external onlyOwner {\r\n        if (token == address(0)) revert PriceOracle__ZeroAddress();\r\n        if (priceFeed == address(0)) revert PriceOracle__InvalidPriceFeed();\r\n\r\n        // Validate price feed by attempting to get latest round data\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface feed = AggregatorV3Interface(priceFeed);\r\n        try feed.latestRoundData() returns (\r\n            uint80,\r\n            int256 answer,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint80\r\n        ) {\r\n            if (answer <= 0) revert PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n        } catch {\r\n            revert PriceOracle__InvalidPriceFeed();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Add to supported tokens if new\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) {\r\n            supportedTokens.push(token);\r\n            isSupportedToken[token] = true;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        priceFeeds[token] = feed;\r\n        emit PriceFeedUpdated(token, priceFeed, tokenSymbol);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Remove a price feed for a token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     */\r\n    function removePriceFeed(address token) external onlyOwner {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) revert PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n\r\n        delete priceFeeds[token];\r\n        isSupportedToken[token] = false;\r\n\r\n        // Remove from supported tokens array\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < supportedTokens.length; i++) {\r\n            if (supportedTokens[i] == token) {\r\n                supportedTokens[i] = supportedTokens[\r\n                    supportedTokens.length - 1\r\n                ];\r\n                supportedTokens.pop();\r\n                break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit PriceFeedRemoved(token);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the latest price for a token in USD\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return price The price in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     */\r\n    function getPrice(address token) external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        PriceData memory priceData = _getPriceData(token);\r\n\r\n        if (!priceData.isValid) {\r\n            revert PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return priceData.price;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get detailed price data for a token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return priceData Struct containing price, timestamp, and validity\r\n     */\r\n    function getPriceData(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external view returns (PriceData memory) {\r\n        return _getPriceData(token);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get token value in USD\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param amount The token amount (in token's native decimals)\r\n     * @param tokenDecimals The token's decimal places\r\n     * @return valueInUSD The value in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     */\r\n    function getTokenValueInUSD(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint8 tokenDecimals\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 valueInUSD) {\r\n        uint256 price = this.getPrice(token);\r\n\r\n        // Normalize token amount to 18 decimals, then multiply by price\r\n        if (tokenDecimals <= 18) {\r\n            uint256 normalizedAmount = amount * (10 ** (18 - tokenDecimals));\r\n            valueInUSD = (normalizedAmount * price) / 1e18;\r\n        } else {\r\n            // If token has > 18 decimals (rare), scale down\r\n            uint256 normalizedAmount = amount / (10 ** (tokenDecimals - 18));\r\n            valueInUSD = (normalizedAmount * price) / 1e18;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return valueInUSD;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get USD amount required for specific token amount\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param usdAmount The USD amount desired (18 decimals)\r\n     * @param tokenDecimals The token's decimal places\r\n     * @return tokenAmount The token amount needed\r\n     */\r\n    function getTokenAmountForUSD(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 usdAmount,\r\n        uint8 tokenDecimals\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 tokenAmount) {\r\n        uint256 price = this.getPrice(token);\r\n\r\n        if (price == 0) revert PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n\r\n        // Calculate token amount needed (in 18 decimals)\r\n        uint256 tokenAmount18Decimals = (usdAmount * 1e18) / price;\r\n\r\n        // Convert to token's native decimals\r\n        if (tokenDecimals <= 18) {\r\n            tokenAmount = tokenAmount18Decimals / (10 ** (18 - tokenDecimals));\r\n        } else {\r\n            tokenAmount = tokenAmount18Decimals * (10 ** (tokenDecimals - 18));\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return tokenAmount;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if a price is stale\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return isStale True if price is stale\r\n     */\r\n    function isPriceStale(address token) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) return true;\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n\r\n        try priceFeed.latestRoundData() returns (\r\n            uint80,\r\n            int256,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint256 updatedAt,\r\n            uint80\r\n        ) {\r\n            return block.timestamp - updatedAt > stalePriceThreshold;\r\n        } catch {\r\n            return true;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all supported tokens\r\n     * @return Array of supported token addresses\r\n     */\r\n    function getSupportedTokens() external view returns (address[] memory) {\r\n        return supportedTokens;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the number of supported tokens\r\n     * @return count The count of supported tokens\r\n     */\r\n    function getSupportedTokenCount() external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return supportedTokens.length;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Update stale price threshold\r\n     * @param newThreshold New threshold in seconds\r\n     */\r\n    function setStalePriceThreshold(uint256 newThreshold) external onlyOwner {\r\n        if (newThreshold == 0 || newThreshold > 1 days) {\r\n            revert PriceOracle__InvalidThreshold();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        uint256 oldThreshold = stalePriceThreshold;\r\n        stalePriceThreshold = newThreshold;\r\n\r\n        emit StalePriceThresholdUpdated(oldThreshold, newThreshold);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get price feed decimals for a token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return decimals The decimals of the price feed\r\n     */\r\n    function getPriceFeedDecimals(address token) external view returns (uint8) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) revert PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n        return priceFeed.decimals();\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get price feed description for a token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return description The description of the price feed\r\n     */\r\n    function getPriceFeedDescription(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external view returns (string memory) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) revert PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n        return priceFeed.description();\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Internal Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Internal function to get price data with validation\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return priceData Struct containing price information\r\n     */\r\n    function _getPriceData(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) internal view returns (PriceData memory priceData) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) revert PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n        if (address(priceFeed) == address(0))\r\n            revert PriceOracle__PriceFeedNotSet();\r\n\r\n        try priceFeed.latestRoundData() returns (\r\n            uint80 roundId,\r\n            int256 answer,\r\n            uint256 startedAt,\r\n            uint256 updatedAt,\r\n            uint80 answeredInRound\r\n        ) {\r\n            // Validate round data\r\n            if (answeredInRound < roundId) {\r\n                priceData.isValid = false;\r\n                return priceData;\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Check for stale price\r\n            uint256 timeSinceUpdate = block.timestamp - updatedAt;\r\n            if (timeSinceUpdate > stalePriceThreshold) {\r\n                revert PriceOracle__StalePrice(timeSinceUpdate);\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Check for invalid price\r\n            if (answer <= 0) {\r\n                revert PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Get price feed decimals and normalize to 18 decimals\r\n            uint8 decimals = priceFeed.decimals();\r\n            uint256 price;\r\n\r\n            if (decimals < PRICE_DECIMALS) {\r\n                price = uint256(answer) * (10 ** (PRICE_DECIMALS - decimals));\r\n            } else if (decimals > PRICE_DECIMALS) {\r\n                price = uint256(answer) / (10 ** (decimals - PRICE_DECIMALS));\r\n            } else {\r\n                price = uint256(answer);\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            priceData = PriceData({\r\n                price: price,\r\n                timestamp: updatedAt,\r\n                roundId: roundId,\r\n                isValid: true\r\n            });\r\n        } catch {\r\n            revert PriceOracle__InvalidRoundData();\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if price feed is responsive\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return isResponsive True if price feed is working\r\n     */\r\n    function _isPriceFeedResponsive(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) internal view returns (bool) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) return false;\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n\r\n        try priceFeed.latestRoundData() returns (\r\n            uint80,\r\n            int256 answer,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint80\r\n        ) {\r\n            return answer > 0;\r\n        } catch {\r\n            return false;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0xc695bf2655a7dcd76f6d21fdd2ed54ae46eccfefb465c27974d0f15cce4538df","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/ReputationManager.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * @title ReputationManager\r\n * @notice Manages user reputation scores for decentralized lending platform\r\n * @dev Implements multi-factor reputation system with decay, anti-gaming, and co-signing\r\n */\r\ncontract ReputationManager is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    bytes32 public constant LENDING_POOL_ROLE = keccak256(\"LENDING_POOL_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant COSIGNING_ROLE = keccak256(\"COSIGNING_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant VERIFIER_ROLE = keccak256(\"VERIFIER_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant DATA_FEED_ROLE = keccak256(\"DATA_FEED_ROLE\");\r\n\r\n    // Reputation score bounds\r\n    uint256 public constant MIN_REPUTATION = 0;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_REPUTATION = 1000;\r\n    uint256 public constant STARTING_REPUTATION = 100;\r\n\r\n    // Reputation weights (out of 100 for percentage)\r\n    uint256 public constant REPAYMENT_WEIGHT = 50; // 50% weight\r\n    uint256 public constant TRANSACTION_WEIGHT = 25; // 25% weight\r\n    uint256 public constant COSIGNING_WEIGHT = 15; // 15% weight\r\n    uint256 public constant WALLET_AGE_WEIGHT = 10; // 10% weight\r\n\r\n    // Decay parameters\r\n    uint256 public constant DECAY_START_DAYS = 90; // Start decay after 90 days of inactivity\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_DECAY_PERCENTAGE = 50; // Max 50% reputation loss\r\n    uint256 public constant DECAY_PERIOD_DAYS = 180; // Full decay over 180 days\r\n\r\n    // Anti-gaming parameters\r\n    uint256 public constant REPUTATION_CAP_PERIOD = 1 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_REPUTATION_GAIN_PER_PERIOD = 50;\r\n    uint256 public constant WALLET_AGE_CAP_DAYS = 365; // Wallet age contribution caps at 1 year\r\n    uint256 public constant COSIGN_COOLDOWN = 30 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_COSIGN_BONUS = 100;\r\n\r\n    // Off-chain verification bonuses\r\n    uint256 public constant EMAIL_VERIFICATION_BONUS = 60;\r\n    uint256 public constant PHONE_VERIFICATION_BONUS = 140;\r\n\r\n    // Repayment scoring\r\n    uint256 public constant SUCCESSFUL_REPAYMENT_BASE = 20;\r\n    uint256 public constant DEFAULT_PENALTY_BASE = 100;\r\n    uint256 public constant COSIGNER_PENALTY_MULTIPLIER = 30; // 30% of borrower penalty\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct ReputationData {\r\n        uint256 baseScore;\r\n        uint256 totalTransactions;\r\n        uint256 uniqueCounterparties;\r\n        uint256 totalValueTransferred;\r\n        uint256 successfulRepayments;\r\n        uint256 totalRepaymentValue;\r\n        uint256 defaults;\r\n        uint256 totalDefaultValue;\r\n        uint256 walletCreationTime;\r\n        uint256 lastActivityTimestamp;\r\n        uint256 lastReputationUpdate;\r\n        bool emailVerified;\r\n        bool phoneVerified;\r\n        uint256 coSigningBonus;\r\n        uint256 reputationGainedToday;\r\n        uint256 lastDailyResetTimestamp;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct CoSigningHistory {\r\n        mapping(address => uint256) coSignCount; // borrower => count\r\n        mapping(address => uint256) lastCoSignTime; // borrower => timestamp\r\n        uint256 totalActiveCoSigns;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Storage ============\r\n\r\n    mapping(address => ReputationData) private reputationData;\r\n    mapping(address => CoSigningHistory) private coSigningHistory;\r\n    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private hasInteracted; // For unique counterparties\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event ReputationUpdated(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        uint256 oldScore,\r\n        uint256 newScore,\r\n        string reason\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event OffChainVerification(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        string verificationType,\r\n        uint256 bonusAdded\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event ReputationDecay(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        uint256 decayAmount,\r\n        uint256 daysSinceActivity\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event ReputationPenalty(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        uint256 penaltyAmount,\r\n        string reason\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event OnChainMetricsUpdated(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        uint256 transactions,\r\n        uint256 counterparties,\r\n        uint256 totalValue\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error ReputationManager__Unauthorized();\r\n    error ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n    error ReputationManager__AlreadyVerified();\r\n    error ReputationManager__ReputationCapReached();\r\n    error ReputationManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor() {\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n        _grantRole(VERIFIER_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n        _grantRole(DATA_FEED_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the current reputation score for a user (with decay applied)\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     * @return The calculated reputation score\r\n     */\r\n    function getReputationScore(address user) external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return _calculateReputationScore(user);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get detailed reputation data for a user\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     * @return ReputationData struct with all metrics\r\n     */\r\n    function getReputationData(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (ReputationData memory) {\r\n        return reputationData[user];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Initialize reputation for a new user\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     */\r\n    function initializeReputation(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DATA_FEED_ROLE) {\r\n        if (user == address(0)) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[user];\r\n\r\n        // Only initialize if not already initialized\r\n        if (data.walletCreationTime == 0) {\r\n            data.baseScore = STARTING_REPUTATION;\r\n            data.walletCreationTime = block.timestamp;\r\n            data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n            data.lastReputationUpdate = block.timestamp;\r\n            data.lastDailyResetTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n            emit ReputationUpdated(\r\n                user,\r\n                0,\r\n                STARTING_REPUTATION,\r\n                \"Initial reputation\"\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Record successful loan repayment and update reputation\r\n     * @param borrower The address of the borrower\r\n     * @param loanAmount The amount repaid\r\n     */\r\n    function recordSuccessfulRepayment(\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        if (borrower == address(0)) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) revert }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Calculate wallet age score\r\n     */\r\n    function _calculateWalletAgeScore(\r\n        ReputationData storage data\r\n    ) internal view returns (uint256) {\r\n }\r\n\r\n        return basePenalty;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Calculate co-signing bonus with diminishing returns\r\n     */\r\n    function _calculateCoSigningBonus(\r\n devdoc.details: Provides unified interface for getting token prices in USD

returns._0: price The price in USD (18 decimals)
priceData Struct containing price, timestamp, and validity
decimals The decimals of the price feed
description The description of the price feed
count The count of supported tokens

params.amount: The token amount (in token's native decimals)

returns._0: isStale True if price is stale

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted signaling this. _Available since v3.1._

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call, an admin role bearer except when using {AccessControl-_setupRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

params.borrower: The address of the borrower who defaulted
params.loanAmount: The amount of the defaulted loan

params.loanAmount: The amount of the defaulted loan

params.bonusToRemove: The exact bonus amount that was originally added

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `account`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

*/\r\ncontract ReputationManager is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    bytes32 public constant LENDING_POOL_ROLE = keccak256(\"LENDING_POOL_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant COSIGNING_ROLE = keccak256(\"COSIGNING_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant VERIFIER_ROLE = keccak256(\"VERIFIER_ROLE\");\r\n 50% weight\r\n    uint256 public constant TRANSACTION_WEIGHT = 25; // 25% weight\r\n    uint256 public constant COSIGNING_WEIGHT = 15; // 15% weight\r\n    uint256 public constant WALLET_AGE_WEIGHT = 10; // 10% weight\r\n\r\n    // Decay parameters\r\n    uint256 public constant DECAY_START_DAYS = 90; // Start decay after 90 days of inactivity\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_DECAY_PERCENTAGE = 50; // Max 50% reputation loss\r\n    uint256 public constant DECAY_PERIOD_DAYS = 180; // Full decay over 180 days\r\n\r\n    // Anti-gaming parameters\r\n    uint256 public constant REPUTATION_CAP_PERIOD = 1 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_REPUTATION_GAIN_PER_PERIOD = 50;\r\n    uint256 public constant WALLET_AGE_CAP_DAYS = 365; // Wallet age contribution caps at 1 year\r\n    uint256 public constant COSIGN_COOLDOWN = 30 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_COSIGN_BONUS = 100;\r\n\r\n    // Off-chain verification bonuses\r\n    uint256 public constant EMAIL_VERIFICATION_BONUS = 60;\r\n    uint256 public constant PHONE_VERIFICATION_BONUS = 140;\r\n\r\n    // Repayment scoring\r\n    uint256 public constant SUCCESSFUL_REPAYMENT_BASE = 20;\r\n    uint256 public constant DEFAULT_PENALTY_BASE = 100;\r\n    uint256 public constant COSIGNER_PENALTY_MULTIPLIER = 30; // 30% of borrower penalty\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct ReputationData {\r\n        uint256 baseScore;\r\n        uint256 totalTransactions;\r\n        uint256 uniqueCounterparties;\r\n        uint256 totalValueTransferred;\r\n        uint256 successfulRepayments;\r\n        uint256 totalRepaymentValue;\r\n        uint256 defaults;\r\n        uint256 totalDefaultValue;\r\n        uint256 walletCreationTime;\r\n        uint256 lastActivityTimestamp;\r\n        uint256 lastReputationUpdate;\r\n        bool emailVerified;\r\n        bool phoneVerified;\r\n        uint256 coSigningBonus;\r\n        uint256 reputationGainedToday;\r\n        uint256 lastDailyResetTimestamp;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct CoSigningHistory {\r\n        mapping(address => uint256) coSignCount; // borrower => count\r\n        mapping(address => uint256) lastCoSignTime; // borrower => timestamp\r\n        uint256 totalActiveCoSigns;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Storage ============\r\n\r\n    mapping(address => counterparties\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event ReputationUpdated(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        uint256 oldScore,\r\n        uint256 newScore,\r\n        string reason\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event OffChainVerification(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        string verificationType,\r\n        uint256 bonusAdded\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event ReputationDecay(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        uint256 decayAmount,\r\n        uint256 daysSinceActivity\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event ReputationPenalty(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        uint256 penaltyAmount,\r\n        string reason\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event OnChainMetricsUpdated(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        uint256 transactions,\r\n        uint256 counterparties,\r\n        uint256 totalValue\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error ReputationManager__Unauthorized();\r\n    error ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n    error ReputationManager__AlreadyVerified();\r\n    error ReputationManager__ReputationCapReached();\r\n    error ReputationManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor() {\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n        _grantRole(VERIFIER_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n        _grantRole(DATA_FEED_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the current reputation score for a user (with decay applied)\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     * @return The calculated reputation score\r\n     */\r\n    function getReputationScore(address user) external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return _calculateReputationScore(user);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get detailed reputation data for a user\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     * @return ReputationData struct with all metrics\r\n     */\r\n    function getReputationData(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (ReputationData memory) {\r\n        return reputationData[user];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Initialize reputation for a new user\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     */\r\n    function initializeReputation(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DATA_FEED_ROLE) {\r\n        if (user == address(0)) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[user];\r\n\r\n        // Only initialize if not already initialized\r\n        if (data.walletCreationTime == 0) {\r\n            data.baseScore = STARTING_REPUTATION;\r\n            data.walletCreationTime = block.timestamp;\r\n            data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n            data.lastReputationUpdate = block.timestamp;\r\n            data.lastDailyResetTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n            emit ReputationUpdated(\r\n                user,\r\n                0,\r\n                STARTING_REPUTATION,\r\n                \"Initial reputation\"\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Record successful loan repayment and update reputation\r\n     * @param borrower The address of the borrower\r\n     * @param loanAmount The amount repaid\r\n     */\r\n    function recordSuccessfulRepayment(\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        if (borrower == address(0)) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        _ensureInitialized(borrower);\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[borrower];\r\n        uint256 oldScore = _calculateReputationScore(borrower);\r\n\r\n        // Update repayment history\r\n        data.successfulRepayments++;\r\n        data.totalRepaymentValue += loanAmount;\r\n        data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        // Calculate reputation bonus based on loan amount\r\n        uint256 bonus = _calculateRepaymentBonus(loanAmount);\r\n\r\n        // Check daily cap\r\n        _checkAndResetDailyCap(borrower);\r\n        if (\r\n            data.reputationGainedToday + bonus > MAX_REPUTATION_GAIN_PER_PERIOD\r\n        ) {\r\n            bonus = MAX_REPUTATION_GAIN_PER_PERIOD - data.reputationGainedToday;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        data.baseScore = _min(data.baseScore + bonus, MAX_REPUTATION);\r\n        data.reputationGainedToday += bonus;\r\n\r\n        uint256 newScore = _calculateReputationScore(borrower);\r\n        emit ReputationUpdated(\r\n            borrower,\r\n            oldScore,\r\n            newScore,\r\n            \"Successful repayment\"\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Record loan default and apply penalty\r\n     * @param borrower The address of the borrower who defaulted\r\n     * @param loanAmount The amount of the defaulted loan\r\n     */\r\n    function recordDefault(\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        if (borrower == address(0)) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        _ensureInitialized(borrower);\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[borrower];\r\n        uint256 oldScore = _calculateReputationScore(borrower);\r\n\r\n        // Update default history\r\n        data.defaults++;\r\n        data.totalDefaultValue += loanAmount;\r\n        data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        // Calculate penalty (severe)\r\n
